title: Jake Barber in the GATE program as a child
summary: Jake Barber tells of Jake Barber in the GATE program as a child, about Barber's childhood at unspecified, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> I was in the gate program as a kid. Gate program is a program that it's an acronym for gifted and talented education

plain: Jake Barber, speaking on a podcast episode about being taken into a UFO programme as a child, says he was in the GATE programme as a kid. He explains that GATE stands for gifted and talented education, a school track for bright children. He tells it as an early step in how, he says, he was picked out when young.
